object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: For each start that ends with status 2 (a non-repository folder, a subfolder of a clone, a missing path, an unlistable root), run mellon-mcp with --repo-root as a relative path. Do it once without --log-level and once with --log-level ERROR. Expected: in both runs standard error holds the reason and the folder's absolute path. A probe with absolute paths gave '<path> is not inside a git repository (run `git init` there)' and 'repo root <path> is not a directory', both also with --log-level ERROR.
